patch_description:
This crossover version keeps the strongest parts of the prior implementations while pushing harder on regime robustness.  
The feature set is intentionally biased toward short lookbacks, rolling z-scores, and “change in market character” signals such as volatility trend, efficiency trend, and autocorrelation trend. It also adds a few multiplicative interactions that often generalize better than the raw components alone, while keeping the total feature count under the 80-feature limit.

On the model side, the XGBoost configuration is made slightly less rigid than the current program: fewer heavy penalties, a bit more tree depth, and a moderate estimator count with stronger early stopping. This is meant to reduce the prediction collapse seen in prior runs while still limiting overfit across the train→test→val regime shifts.

All features use only past data, and the interface / outputs remain unchanged.
